description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the lands in Heenkenda, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Kurukulawa, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District , Mattumagama, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District , Galudupita & Nawammhara Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District , Mattumagala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation deposits for lands acquired by the state. The content specifically deals with land acquisition matters, including detailed descriptions of land parcels (names, plot numbers, extents, locations), compensation amounts, and banking details for deposited funds. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land acquisition and property-related administrative procedures.
